title: II الكناية هاء
description: Rules regarding the recitation of the hāʾ al-kināyah on some particular words

yuadih_and_its_companions_qasr.title: Qaṣr on the hāʾ al-kināyah of يُؤَدِّه, نُوَلِّه, نُصْلِه, نُؤْتِه
yuadih_and_its_companions_qasr.description: The hāʾ al-kināyah in these particular words has differences between the qirāʾāt. Imams Qalun and Hisham will recite it with qaṣr.
yuadih_and_its_companions_qasr.note: This is one of two options for Imam Hisham

yuadih_and_its_companions_silah.title: Ṣilah on the hāʾ al-kināyah of يُؤَدِّه, نُوَلِّه, نُصْلِه, نُؤْتِه
yuadih_and_its_companions_silah.description: The hāʾ al-kināyah in these particular words has differences between the qirāʾāt. Imams Warsh, Ibn Kathir, Hafs, Ibn Dhakwan, Kisai, and Hisham will recite it with ṣilah.
yuadih_and_its_companions_silah.note: This is one of two options for Imam Hisham

alqih_sukoon.title: Sukūn on the hāʾ al-kināyah of أَلْقِه
alqih_sukoon.description: The hāʾ al-kināyah in the word أَلْقِه has differences between the qirāʾāt. Imams Abu 'Amr, 'Asim, Hamza will recite it with sukūn.

alqih_qasr.title: Qaṣr on the hāʾ al-kināyah of أَلْقِهِ
alqih_qasr.description: The hāʾ al-kināyah in the word أَلْقِه has differences between the qirāʾāt. Imams Qalun, Hisham will recite it with qaṣr.
alqih_qasr.note: This is one of two options for Imam Hisham

alqih_silah.title: Ṣilah on the hāʾ al-kināyah of أَلْقِهِۦ
alqih_silah.description: The hāʾ al-kināyah in the word أَلْقِه has differences between the qirāʾāt. Imams Hisham, Kisai, Ibn Dhakwan, Ibn Kathir, and Warsh will recite it with ṣilah.
alqih_silah.note: This is one of two options for Imam Hisham

yataqih_sukoon.title: Sukūn on the hāʾ al-kināyah of يَتَّقْه
yataqih_sukoon.description: The hāʾ al-kināyah in the word يَتَّقْه has differences between the qirāʾāt. Imams Abu 'Amr, Shu'bah, Khallad will recite it with sukūn.
yataqih_sukoon.note: This is one of two options for Imam Khallad

yataqih_qasr.title: Qaṣr on the hāʾ al-kināyah of يَتَّقْهِ
yataqih_qasr.description: The hāʾ al-kināyah in the word يَتَّقْه has differences between the qirāʾāt. Imams Qalun, Hisham will recite it with qaṣr.
yataqih_qasr.note: This is one of two options for Imam Hisham

yataqih_silah.title: Ṣilah on the hāʾ al-kināyah of يَتَّقْهِۦ
yataqih_silah.description: The hāʾ al-kināyah in the word يَتَّقْه has differences between the qirāʾāt. Imams Hisham, Khallad, Kisai, Khalaf, Ibn Dhakwan, Ibn Kathir, and Warsh will recite it with ṣilah.
yataqih_silah.note: This is one of two options for Imam Hisham and Imam Khallad

yataqih_sukoon_of_qaf.title: Sukūn on the qāf and kasrah on ha al-kināyah of يَتَّقْهِ
yataqih_sukoon_of_qaf.description: The hāʾ al-kināyah in the word يَتَّقْه has differences between the qirāʾāt. Imams Hafs will recite it with sukūn on the qāf and kasrah on ha.

yatih_sukoon.title: Sukūn on the ha al-kināyah of يَأْتِه
yatih_sukoon.description: The hāʾ al-kināyah in the word يَأْتِه has differences between the qirāʾāt. Imam Sūsī will recite it with sukūn on the ha.

yatih_qasr.title: Qaṣr on the hāʾ al-kināyah of يَأْتِهِ
yatih_qasr.description: The hāʾ al-kināyah in the word يَأْتِه has differences between the qirāʾāt. Imams Hisham and Qalun will recite it with qaṣr.
yatih_qasr.note: This is one of two options for Imam Hisham and Imam Qalun

yatih_silah.title: Ṣilah on the hāʾ al-kināyah of يَأْتِهِۦ
yatih_silah.description: The hāʾ al-kināyah in the word يَأْتِه has differences between the qirāʾāt. The denoted imams will recite it with ṣilah.
yatih_silah.note: This is one of two options for Imam Hisham and Imam Qalun
